secrets.name: DASHBOARD_API_TOKEN
secrets.description: Bearer token the dashboard sends to authenticate /api/* calls. Required for the dashboard to function. Generated as a development placeholder; replace with your own if desired.

secrets.name: GREEN_API_ID_INSTANCE
secrets.description: Green API instance id for WhatsApp integration (https://green-api.com). Optional — without it WhatsApp sync is inactive.

secrets.name: GREEN_API_TOKEN
secrets.description: Green API instance token for WhatsApp integration. Optional.

secrets.name: WHATSAPP_GROUP_ID
secrets.description: WhatsApp group chat id (format 1234567890-1234567890@g.us). Optional — enables reconciliation cron.

secrets.name: CARDCOM_TERMINAL_NUMBER
secrets.description: Cardcom terminal number for billing reconciliation. Optional.

secrets.name: CARDCOM_API_NAME
secrets.description: Cardcom API name for billing reconciliation. Optional.

secrets.name: CARDCOM_API_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Cardcom API password for billing reconciliation. Optional.

secrets.name: NVIDIA_API_KEY
secrets.description: NVIDIA NIM API key for AI insights chat (https://build.nvidia.com). Optional — without it the chat feature returns an error.

secrets.name: NOTIFY_EMAIL_TO
secrets.description: Email address to send daily/weekly digest to. Optional.

secrets.name: SMTP_HOST
secrets.description: SMTP server host for notification emails. Optional.

secrets.name: SMTP_USER
secrets.description: SMTP username for notification emails. Optional.

secrets.name: SMTP_PASS
secrets.description: SMTP password for notification emails. Optional.

secrets.name: NOTIFY_WHATSAPP_PHONE
secrets.description: Phone number to send WhatsApp digest notifications to. Optional.
